title: AnchorHistoryLine
description: One line of anchors.jsonl in a session recording, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): an anchor added, moved or removed, sampled with each mesh snapshot. The first sample, when the recording opens, writes every anchor as add; the final sample, when it closes, writes every keyframe, image and marked anchor with final true and no movement threshold. Otherwise updates only for anchors that moved more than about 1 mm or 0.05 degrees since their last line. Checked by validate-recording, not by this schema: t never decreases, an anchor's first line is an add, transform is null exactly for remove, frame is set exactly for keyframe anchors, and capture_id is set only on final lines.

transform.description: Anchor to world, or null for remove.

frame.description: The keyframe's frame for a keyframe anchor, else null.

final.description: true for the lines of a final sample (written whether or not the anchor moved).

capture_id.description: On a final sample taken at a segment's session-end reads (with continuous_session), that segment's capture_id; else null.

kind.title: AnchorHistoryKind
kind.description: keyframe: the anchor placed at a keyframe. image: a detected image anchor. mesh: a mesh anchor. marked: an anchor markAnchor placed.
